idea-plugin.name: Graphs for TorchSharp
idea-plugin.description:
Live plots for C# machine learning, inside Rider.

Your C# program calls the small TorchSharpGraph library (Plot.Scatter, Plot.Line, Plot.Function, Plot.Loss, Plot.Heatmap, Plot.Image) and the Graphs window draws the plots while it runs: data points, a curve moving into place, the loss going down. Tensors, arrays and lists are all accepted.

  • Scatter, line and function plots, loss curves with a log-scale switch, heatmaps with contour lines, and tensors shown as pictures (one picture or a grid of them).
  • Hover to read values, scroll to zoom, drag to move, double-click to reset, export as PNG.
  • The last run stays visible after the program ends; the next run starts afresh.
  • The window only appears in projects that use the library, or when plots actually arrive.

Programs connect over the local loopback address (127.0.0.1) only. The plugin makes no other network connections and sends nothing anywhere. Without Rider, the library saves the plots as PNG files instead.
